accounting_rule: Logical bytes, allocated bytes and df available-byte change are separate measures and are not added together.
attribution_limit: The df interval delta is the observed filesystem change during the retirement window. Concurrent allocations or frees can make it differ from the exact unlinked allocation total.
source_layer_conclusion: The positive controlled test and sustained df growth prove that unlink reclaimed physical /root/data capacity; this was not a whiteout-only result.
